children: Kredittbanken ASA chose FIS’s PRIME in the Cloud, running on AWS, to modernize its loans, deposits and credit card platform, extending its long-standing TSYS/FIS relationship.
New client win/expansion supports FIS issuing revenue and validates cloud migration demand.
Cloud delivery can improve margins and scalability versus on‑prem processing.
Broader scope suggests deeper wallet share and stickier recurring fees.
Reduces churn risk and signals continued cross-sell within FIS.
Faster innovation cadence can attract more issuers and upsell modules.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of FIS’s strategy to shift issuers to managed cloud platforms. A larger catalyst would require disclosed financial terms, additional issuer wins, or quantified impacts to processing volumes or margins.
